title: VIRA Canonical Event Envelope
description: Universal event envelope matching the Rust gracemo-kernel EventBus and gracemo-types.

id.description: Unique UUIDv4 identifying this event instance.

trace_id.description: Distributed correlation ID tracing an interaction from acoustic input to motor/screen actuation.

session_id.description: Identifier for the continuous human-robot interactive session.

timestamp.description: Unix epoch timestamp in seconds (or milliseconds when specified in schema_version 2.0).

timestamp_iso.description: ISO-8601 UTC representation of event creation time.

observed_by.description: Component or node name that captured or synthesized the observation.

sequence.description: Monotonically increasing sequence number per source.

parent_event_id.description: Causal parent event ID establishing provenance in the append-only ledger.

data.description: Strongly typed payload associated with the event type.
